GPX schema locations and version not parsed correctly

When parsing GPX files, the schema locations and version information are not being extracted properly. This affects GPX files that rely on schema location information and version-specific parsing.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import gpxpy

# GPX with schema location
gpx_content = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx creator="Garmin Connect" version="1.1"
  xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1 http://www.topografix.com/GPX/11.xsd"
  xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1"
  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <metadata>
  </metadata>
  <trk>
    <name>Test Track</name>
  </trk>
</gpx>'''

gpx = gpxpy.parse(gpx_content)
print("Schema locations:", gpx.schema_locations)  # Should contain schema info
print("Version:", gpx.version)  # Should be '1.1'
```

The schema_locations attribute is not populated and version information may not be correctly handled during parsing.
</issue>
